# Vexaris

> Hosted storefront platform for selling digital products — 0% commission, instant automatic delivery. Also available as self-hosted software.

Vexaris is a selling platform for digital goods: e-pins, license keys, software packages, Minecraft plugins, server setups, Discord boosts, e-books and downloadable files. Sellers get a hosted store on `x.vexaris.app` (no server setup required) or can self-host the script.

- Homepage: https://vexaris.net/
- Features: https://vexaris.net/features
- Pricing: https://vexaris.net/pricing (Free $0, Starter $6.99, Professional $14.99, Enterprise $39.99; yearly billing −20%)
- Blog: https://vexaris.net/blog
- License check: https://vexaris.net/license-check
- Live demo: https://demo.vexaris.net
- Status: https://status.vexaris.com.tr
- Contact: info@vexaris.net

## Pricing and plans

- Free — $0 forever: 7 products, $100 revenue cap, 10 GB traffic, hosted store, `x.vexaris.app` subdomain, 1 theme, support tickets.
- Starter — $6.99/month (or $5.59/month billed yearly): 35 products, $1,000 revenue, 50 GB traffic, custom domain, coupon system, 2 themes.
- Professional — $14.99/month (or $11.99/month billed yearly): 75 products, $5,000 revenue, 200 GB traffic, API access, Vexaris AI, 3 themes.
- Enterprise — $39.99/month (or $31.99/month billed yearly): unlimited products and revenue, 1,000 GB traffic, 30+ team seats, all themes.
- Vexaris takes 0% commission on sales. No listing fees, no monthly platform fee on Free.

## How it works

1. Publish your product: upload zip/rar/7z/jar files or paste one-per-line e-pins and license keys. Price, discount, category and ordering in a single form.
2. Customer checks out: cart, coupons, balance or card payment with silent Turnstile verification.
3. System delivers: as soon as the payment is approved, a stock line is pulled, the license key is signed, and files land in the customer's library. Average delivery time: 0.4 seconds.
4. Support and updates: tickets, new versions and download lists are built in.

## Payments

12 payment and sales integrations: Shopier, PayTR, iyzico, Stripe, PayPal, BitPay, Cryptomus, Paywant, Whop, Dodo Payments, Paddle and Lemon Squeezy. Crypto, installments, 3D Secure, saved cards, IPN/webhook approval, and balance (wallet) payments. Card details never touch Vexaris servers.

## Store modules

- Product & stock management (unlimited and single-stock modes; sales auto-close when stock runs out)
- Coupons & balance (percentage/gift coupons, wallet payments, refunds to balance)
- Support tickets (categories, priorities, messaging, history)
- Roles & permissions (admin, manager, moderator, support team)
- Themes (default, azure, ember) and integrations (social login, captcha, live support)
- Mail templates & SEO (customizable transactional mails, titles, descriptions, OG tags, canonical, JSON-LD)
- Blog, announcements, FAQ, reviews, licenses, version tracking
- Maintenance mode, scheduled publishing, categories, sliders, download tokens
- Vexaris AI: product descriptions, announcements and SEO fields, plus a store assistant

## Accounts and access

- Registration is open and instant — no application, no manual review.
- Sign-in supports email/password plus Google, Discord, GitHub and Microsoft OAuth.
- Forgot-password flow uses a 6-digit emailed code; sessions can be managed per device.
- Free plan: self-serve, hosted store on an `x.vexaris.app` subdomain, 7 products.
- Paid plans add a custom domain, higher product/revenue/traffic limits, API access and Vexaris AI.

## Licensing

- Each store has a license key and a domain allow-list; plans and limits are enforced per domain.
- Updates are delivered to licensed stores; new versions appear in the seller's download list.
